external_sources.locator: IOM World Migration Report Educators’ Toolkit, Module 1: “What is Migration?”, definition of migration; internal and international migration.

material.locator: UNSD Recommendations (2025, rev. 2), Executive Summary recommendation 1 and Chapter 2 §2(a), “Linking migration to changes in the country of residence”, pp. 6–10; supplementary IOM Module 1 definition.
material.description: Supports the statistical concept of international migration as a change in country of residence. The IOM resource also describes movement within a country; the claim is an educational definition, not an immigration-status determination.
